correctness.rationale: With real uniform smoothness, the supporting norming functional inequality and definition of modulus ρ give 0≤||x+hy||−1−h j(x)y≤2ρ(h) and the counterpart at −y for ||hx−y||, uniformly for all unit pairs. M_t has uniformly bounded Hessian on [3/4,5/4]² for any fixed finite t≥1 and first differential (u+v)/2 at (1,1), yielding error ≤2ρ(h)+C_t h² uniformly. Since D(x,y)=j(x)y−j(y)x is antisymmetric in x,y, its extrema are ±2κ, so taking extrema over unit pairs preserves errors and gives right slopes −κ and κ with ρ(h)=o(h). κ=0 makes B(u,v)=||u||j(u/||u||)(v) symmetric, and hence bilinear positive definite with B(u,u)=||u||², establishing Hilbert characterization. ℓ4² unit witness x=(1,0), y=(1/2,(15/16)^1/4) gives D=3/8. The t=∞ boundary has Hilbert J∞ slope 1, so the excluded exponent is necessary. No extremizers or numerical certification assumed.
